text.name: collision_model
text.data: Compact inline convex collision proxies are generated from original V7 STL surfaces using deterministic local CAD-plane slices and one convex hull per slice, without inflation. These are planar-slice approximations, not surface-certified meshes; a hull may bridge openings within its slice. Six bearings remain visual-only within covered fixed clusters; each linky support has one central-bar hull cropped away from annular bearing-end mating regions. The visual/inertial linky bodies remain complete. Both foot soles retain their named boxes and two post boxes fitted to native V7 plate extents. The robot collision budget is at most 64 geoms, with 256 Genesis pair/contact buffers. Self, adjacent, and neutral collision flags are enabled; MuJoCo contact/constraint solving is enabled with parent filtering disabled, 80 solver iterations, and 1e-8 tolerance. Original visual STL assets/transforms and body kinematics remain unchanged. Single-hull proxies can bridge openings; interface clearance is not certified without simulation. No collision motion tests or model loading were run.

text.name: hardware_assumptions
text.data: Eight MG996R leg servos: kp=3, kd=0.06 N*m*s/rad, torque cap=0.94 N*m; 6 rad/s DC no-load speed reference. Two MG90S shoulders and two SG90 mandibles (CAD case mesh labels remain MG90S): kp=0.6, kd=0.01808782111111, torque cap=0.1808782111111 N*m; 10 rad/s DC no-load speed reference. Speed references describe the motor envelope; the physical model has no imposed speed limit and external loads may back-drive joints faster. Six leg pitch joints have +/-80 degree physical travel and +/-0.9 rad policy target offsets; leg roll targets remain +/-0.15 rad.
